flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Revival/form/RevivalForm, utils/mapping/Revival/Revival.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController (staff-revive-suspension), helpers/{RevivalBaseHelper,TemporaryRevivalHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper}}, api-authorization.properties. Other repos: not relevant
note: Sheet status: Fully paid (2 points); no flow deck. After the officer presses OK in the confirmation modal, the UI immediately calls POST staff-revive-suspension (one request for PS notices, one for TS) and the server processes it synchronously in the same request: validation, marking all active suspensions as revived, then clearing or refilling the suspension fields on VON and eVON. There is no cron or approval in between. Two things to watch. First, the eVON sync (the copy read by eService) and the TS-RED amount payable revert are best-effort: errors are only logged and the response is still a success. Second, revive closes ALL active suspensions (TS and PS) of the notice, not only the type the officer picked. The list of valid revival codes is read from table ocms_suspension_reason (type RV); its content in each environment cannot be verified from the repo. The an_flag='N' reset for PS-ANS (PermanentRevivalHelper.java:206-240) differs from what ticket OCMS-DF-2026-129 expects (an_flag stays Y); which one is final cannot be verified from the repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-029 (payment_acceptance_allowed and eservice_message_code on revive) and OCMS-DF-2026-028 (TS-RED amount), both Closed, Prod deployed.
recommendation: Can be claimed for the revive execution and the suspended_notice and VON updates. State that the eVON sync and the TS-RED amount revert are only best-effort (an error does not cancel the revival) and that revive closes all active suspensions.

steps.step: After the officer presses OK in the confirmation modal, the UI immediately sends the revive request (no queue or cron)
steps.detail: handleComModalOk closes the modal and calls onSubmit (RevivalForm.tsx:269-272); onSubmit calls onAPI (206-210), which POSTs staff-revive-suspension right away, one request for PS notices (109-123) and one for TS (137-151). The body holds noticeNo, suspensionType, revivalReason, revivalRemarks, officerAuthorisingRevival (Revival.ts:17-23). There is no scheduling or approval between confirmation and execution. Function ID OCMS_APPLY_REVIVAL may call this endpoint (api-authorization.properties:65-67). officerAuthorisingRevival is filled by the UI from user.userId and the server takes the payload value as is (SuspensionProcessingController.java:634).

steps.step: The server validates the request: reason and officer are mandatory, remarks max 200 characters, the revival code is in the active list, the notice exists and is currently suspended with the requested type
steps.detail: The controller rejects remarks longer than 200 characters (SuspensionProcessingController.java:639-643). The TS/PS helper then checks noticeNo, revivalReason and officer are present (RevivalBaseHelper.java:114-130), the remarks length (139-145), that the revival code exists in ocms_suspension_reason with status A, source OCMS, type RV (159-186; if the DB read fails the code set is empty so every code is rejected, 93-96), that the notice exists, and that VON.suspension_type equals the requested type (198-207; TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:107-137, PermanentRevivalHelper.java:118-148). The '50 chars' comment in TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:114 is wrong; 200 applies (RevivalBaseHelper.java:140). The content of the revival code list in each environment's database cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: All active suspensions of the notice are marked as revived (current date, reason, remarks, officer)
steps.detail: The staff path (srNo null) loads all active TS and PS suspensions (TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:157-166; RevivalBaseHelper.java:237-262), then updateDatabaseAfterRevivalAll sets date_of_revival = now, revival_reason, revival_remarks, officer_authorising_revival through a native update (RevivalBaseHelper.java:718-724, 278-299). This runs synchronously in the same request (TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:179-190, PermanentRevivalHelper.java:197-204). Note: revive closes ALL active suspensions, not only the type the officer picked.

steps.step: The notice in OCMS (VON) is updated: suspension fields are cleared, or refilled from the suspension that remains
steps.detail: After the revival the remaining active suspensions are looked up (RevivalBaseHelper.java:726-733). If any remain, VON is filled from the latest one with the furthest due_date_of_revival (746, 400-420); if none remain, suspension_type, epr_* and due_date_of_revival are cleared, and for PS also crs_*, payment_acceptance_allowed=Y and eservice_message_code by stage (751, 320-355). PS-ANS additionally resets an_flag='N' (PermanentRevivalHelper.java:206-240); ticket OCMS-DF-2026-129 (Closed, Prod deployed) wants an_flag to stay Y, the code on main does not do that; the final version cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The notice copy used by eService (eVON) is updated the same way as VON
steps.detail: clearEVONSuspension clears the suspension and payment fields on eVON (RevivalBaseHelper.java:559-601), but the whole body sits in a try/catch that only logs the error (603-605), and when no eVON record exists it is skipped with a warning (563-566). So VON can already be revived while eVON is still old, yet the response is still 'Revival Success' and the officer is not told. The 'remaining suspension' path (RevivalBaseHelper.java:747) uses the same pattern. Whether the SyncIntranetInternet cron repairs eVON cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Reduction (TS-RED) revival: amount payable is restored to the value before the reduction
steps.detail: For TS-RED suspensions the helper calls revertCompositionAmountIfReduced (TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:170-177, PermanentRevivalHelper.java:187-195). The value comes from the latest reduction record (RevivalBaseHelper.java:877-891) and is applied to VON and eVON (898-909). It is skipped when the notice is already FP (868-872) or there is no reduction record (880-884, warning only), and an error is only logged with 'Revival succeeded but compo revert failed' (919-923), so the revival is still reported as successful. It depends on ocms_reduced_offence_amount data produced by the fix of OCMS-DF-2026-072 and OCMS-DF-2026-028 (Closed, Prod deployed); production data state cannot be verified from the repo.
